source.description: Project ByteStream load point that reads attacker-controlled VC5 tags and values from the PoC-backed stream.
source.value_from: Reads typed values from attacker-controlled VC5 byte stream; callers interpret them as tags, values, chunk sizes, and image parameters.; value `ret`; from `auto ret = peek<T>();`

sink.description: MSan crash location where the parser reads uninitialized mVC5.iSubband as an array index.

root_cause.description: The parser uses mVC5.iSubband without first verifying that a SubbandNumber tag was seen and initialized the parser state.

tainted_value_origin.description: The attacker-controlled tag stream determines whether SubbandNumber initializes mVC5.iSubband before a LargeCodeblock is parsed.

coarse_trace.summary: Constructs VC5Decompressor with the attacker-controlled ByteStream.
Parses VC5 tags and dispatches LargeCodeblock chunks.
Uses mVC5.iSubband even when the tag sequence did not initialize it.

fine_trace.note: Project-level load point for typed values from the PoC-backed ByteStream; the caller consumes returned values as VC5 fields.
The constructed decompressor receives the same attacker-controlled ByteStream. The stack object `v` contains parser state, including mVC5.iSubband.
The tag is attacker-controlled and determines which parser state fields are initialized before chunk parsing.
This assignment only happens if the tag stream contains VC5Tag::SubbandNumber. The PoC reaches a LargeCodeblock without this required state initialization.
A LargeCodeblock tag dispatches into parseLargeCodeblock regardless of whether mVC5.iSubband has been initialized.
The missing presence check lets an uninitialized parser-state field become an array index. The fix adds hasValue()/getValue() around this use.
MSan reports the use-of-uninitialized-value at this read of mVC5.iSubband.

crash_stack.function: fuzzer::FuzzerDriver(int*, char***, int (*)(unsigned char const*, unsigned long))

origin_context.description: MSan reports the uninitialized value was created by stack allocation of `v`, the VC5Decompressor object containing mVC5.iSubband.
